description: KR7.3 compile-time / memory-proxy trend baseline. Records the shared bench metrics for the four deterministic fixture budgets so tests/scripts/benchmark_trend_gate.py can block on structural drift (source_bytes / typed_exprs / typed_statements / ir_decls / ir_exprs, guarded exactly) and on memory-proxy growth beyond a relative tolerance (proxy_bytes, 10%). duration_us is deliberately NOT stored: it is wall-clock and machine-dependent, so the trend report records it but the binaries' own static max_duration ceilings remain the wall-clock bound. Regenerate intentionally with `benchmark_trend_gate.py <compile_time-bin> <memory_usage-bin> config/benchmark-baseline.json <report> --update` after a reviewed change.
